Heel-raised hold over the toe (hands on.description: Isometric calf hold up on the ball of the foot — builds ankle stiffness and push-off.
cues: Tall on the ball of the foot
Hold still, weight through the big toe

Bent-knee calf raise (seated / supported.description: Calf raise with a bent knee to bias the soleus — the endurance muscle behind late-run push-off.
cues: Knee bent — this is the soleus

Single-leg heel raise off a step, 3s dow.description: Full-range single-leg calf raise with a slow lower — strength and control through the ankle.

Knee-to-wall ankle mobilisation.description: Mobility drill driving the knee past the toes — restores the dorsiflexion running needs.
cues: Drive the knee toward the wall

Subtalar mob → loaded dorsiflexion hold.description: Settles the ankle joint, then loads a deep dorsiflexion hold for range under load.
cues: Settle the ankle, then hold deep

Soleus iso prime — bent-knee calf-raise.description: Short bent-knee calf hold to wake the soleus before running — primes push-off, eases calf soreness.
cues: Bent knee, up on the ball of the foot

Single-leg hip thrust, band at knees.description: Single-leg glute drive with the band cueing the hip out — power and pelvic control.
cues: Shoulders on the bench, drive hips up
Knees press out on the band

Wall-press isometric — hip abduction.description: Isometric push of the outside knee into a wall — switches on the lateral hip that steadies each stride.

Copenhagen.description: Side-plank variation loading the inner thigh — groin and pelvic stability.

Side plank, ball under top knee.description: Side plank with the top knee squeezing a ball — lateral trunk and hip endurance.
cues: Squeeze the ball under the top knee

Standing loaded hip abduction.description: Lifting the leg out to the side under load — direct strength for the glute med.
cues: Lift the leg out to the side

Hip airplanes (fingertips on wall).description: Single-leg hinge with slow rotation — hip control and balance through the stance leg.
cues: Hinge on one leg, rotate slowly
Fingertips on the wall for balance

Loaded thoracic rotation twist.description: Rotation driven from the upper back under light load — frees the trunk for an efficient arm swing.

Standing march — hip band + overhead ser.description: Marching drill linking hip drive with overhead reach — coordinates the running cross-pattern.

Half-kneeling overhead hold / offset pre.description: Pressing or holding overhead from half-kneeling — anti-arch trunk control and shoulder stability.

Deep lunge isometric.description: A held deep lunge — strength and length through the hips and posterior chain.

Suitcase carry.description: Walking tall with weight on one side — anti-tip trunk strength and grip.

Hip thrust, both legs, heavy.description: Loaded two-leg glute drive — the main strength lift for powerful hip extension.

Split-stance hinge (hand on rail).description: A hip hinge in a split stance with support — hamstring and glute strength, balance-friendly.
cues: Hand on the rail for balance

Tripod single-leg RDL.description: Single-leg hinge with a light hand support — posterior-chain strength and stride stability.

Bilateral loaded hinge (RDL / trap bar /.description: A two-leg hip hinge — the foundational posterior-chain strength lift.

Dead bug, dumbbell in one hand.description: Opposite arm and leg reach with ribs down — deep core and anti-extension control.

Landing ladder — slams / snap-downs / de.description: Graded landing drills — teaches the legs to absorb impact softly for running.

Exhale-on-effort breathing (90/90).description: Breathing drill in 90/90 — restores rib position and pelvic-floor coordination.

Lower-trap Y-T-W raises.description: Low-load raises for the mid and lower traps — posture and a relaxed shoulder carriage.
cues: Thumbs up, lift low and wide
From the mid-back, not the neck

Single-arm dumbbell row.description: A hinged single-arm pull — upper-back strength to hold posture late in a run.
cues: Hinge, pull the elbow to the hip

Side-lying open book.description: Side-lying thoracic rotation — opens the upper back and frees the breath.
cues: Open the top arm, follow with the eyes

Banded serratus wall slide / reach.description: Sliding the arms up a wall against a band — serratus and shoulder-blade control.
cues: Slide the arms up the wall

Half-kneeling Pallof hold.description: Anti-rotation press from half-kneeling — the trunk learns to resist twisting each stride.
cues: Press straight out, resist the twist
Ribs down, weight through the stance leg

Split Squat (iso hold).description: A held split-squat bottom position — single-leg strength and tendon loading at moderate load.
cues: Back knee ~2 cm off the floor
